[{"insert":"Deficit Deadlift

The deficit deadlift alternates with the sumo across this cycle. Standing on a plate lengthens the range of motion and forces the hamstrings and glutes to work harder off the floor. Keep the bar close and drive the hips and shoulders up together out of the bottom. Reps drop from Week 2 on this variation, so the weight goes up.
"}]
